notes: Schema v2 separates immutable archived legacy-agent-runs, verified-catalog collector/reviewer records, and direct capture/review records.
Legacy reviewers were non-blind and could inspect/edit collector outputs; this provenance does not imply blind verification or runtime verification.
Verified-catalog reviewers received collector candidate material and are recorded as independent-source-reread-nonblind, not blind.
Unknown call IDs, exact start timestamps, prompt archives, agent paths, reasoning levels, fork turns, attempts, and task metadata are null; no synthetic values are supplied.
direct-capture and direct-capture-review are separate provenance kinds; model is null where no model was involved.
Static code evidence is not runtime verification.
